svg.title: G06 / TERRA HUMIDITY HARVEST engineering mission profile
svg.desc: G06, TERRA HUMIDITY HARVEST. Original project: Direct Air Capture Using Moisture Swing Chemistry. Session G: Exploration Systems Engineering. Scientific question: Which sorbent and cycle concepts maximize net atmospheric CO2 removal after fan work, drying, water management, durability, and downstream carbon fate are counted? Testable hypothesis: Humidity-aware cycle optimization will outperform a fixed schedule in some dry/wet environments, but regeneration water or drying energy may erase benefits elsewhere.. svg.text: Direct Air Capture Using Moisture Swing Chemistry
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Proposed mission: quantify moisture-swing carbon capture as a coupled
carbon, water, transport, and energy cycle. Evaluate how humidity changes
the equilibrium and rate of carbon-dioxide uptake in documented sorbents,
then translate these properties into net removal under a realistic climate.
